question: What COVID-19 publication did Aliou Bouba co-author?
answer: The 2018-2019 AIMS Cameroon MasterCard Foundation and 2019-2022 DAAD scholar has co-authored one COVID-19-related publication titled “Is increased mortality by multiple exposures to COVID-19 an overseen factor when aiming for herd immunity?”
